# exchange.io

No-key currency API with daily ECB reference rates, history back to 1999, conversion, time series, fluctuation, forecasts, and provenance metadata.

Docs: /docs
OpenAPI: /openapi.yaml
Latest: /api/latest?base=USD
Convert: /api/convert?from=USD&to=EUR&amount=100
Timeseries: /api/timeseries?start=2024-01-01&end=2024-01-31&base=USD

Rates are reference data, not financial advice.
